title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the waiting room before the start of the Japan Cup, Symboli Rudolf exchanges friendly greetings with her younger rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But even when her thoughts are on the past and the future, her sights are on the track. Today, as ever, she will do her duty as the Emperor.
